summary: Recent campus crime data for Boise State University indicates a notable increase in incidents involving drug and alcohol violations, particularly in dormitories and common areas. Vandalism cases have also been reported, with one incident leading to a referral for further action. Comparatively, there has been a rise in open cases, such as hit-and-run incidents and violations of protection orders, suggesting an upward trend in unresolved issues. In contrast, incidents of harassment and theft remain relatively stable, though a few cases have been classified as inactive. This month’s data highlights ongoing challenges with substance-related offenses, emphasizing the need for continued vigilance and proactive measures on campus.
